picks.editorial_note: An AI model (Omnii) designed a bacteriophage used in the first-ever treatment of a patient with an antibiotic-resistant infection — a genuine real-world clinical application of generative AI in medicine, not just a lab result.
picks.title: This time, the virus is on the patient’s side. AI helped design it

picks.editorial_note: ARPA-H's $53 million award to an MIT-led team to use generative AI for discovering safer herbicide alternatives is a major federal bet on AI-driven chemistry solving a long-standing agricultural and public-health problem.
picks.title: MIT-led team receives funding to develop next-generation alternatives to modern weed killers

picks.editorial_note: MIT and UBC's WorldParticle model unifies simulation of wildly different physical phenomena — sand, fluids, folding proteins — under one architecture, a notable step toward general-purpose scientific AI.
picks.title: A single AI model simulates the behavior of many substances, from sliding sand to folding proteins

picks.editorial_note: CSIRO's machine-learning imaging technique independently validated the iconic Event Horizon Telescope black hole image and was published in Nature, demonstrating AI's growing role in confirming fundamental physics results.
picks.title: New CSIRO technique confirms iconic black hole image

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL and Carnegie Mellon's new 'Workspace Models' give robots a memory mechanism to recall past observations cheaply, addressing a key bottleneck in deploying learning-based robots outside the lab.
picks.title: A new form of memory helps robots learn complex skills

picks.editorial_note: A $19 million Texas Semiconductor Innovation Fund grant to Texas Tech will build an AI-integrated computing cluster for chip research, reinforcing state-level investment in the AI-semiconductor pipeline.
picks.title: Texas Tech Receives $19 Million Grant to Further Semiconductor Innovation | Texas Tech Now

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's MoU with robotics maker Unitree — building toward a joint lab — signals deepening ties between academia and industry on embodied AI, a fast-moving frontier in robotics commercialization.
picks.title: HKUST and Unitree Sign MoU to Advance Embodied AI and Robotics Collaboration
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: Atos and Inria's strategic partnership to commercialize sovereign AI, robotics, and cybersecurity research reflects Europe's push to translate public AI research into industrial and national-security applications.
picks.title: Atos and Inria enter into a strategic partnership to accelerate the transfer of research into sovereign industrial applications

picks.editorial_note: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation amid a national-security scandal is triggering a government investigation and industry uncertainty, with direct implications for AI hardware supply chains and policy scrutiny of the sector.
picks.title: Nvidia seeks successor after Jensen Huang's exit wobbles AI industry

picks.editorial_note: Science Tokyo's ZEBRA-Prop method lightens the computational cost of predicting material properties from language-model embeddings, a practical efficiency gain for AI-driven materials discovery.
picks.title: 言語モデルを用いた材料物性の予測を軽量化 | Science Tokyo - 東京科学大学
